Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to launch 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Starfell Sword
_curatorNotes: Skill cast (Tap E): hitmark=62f, 248% ATK Geo at lvl=10 (skill multiplier). Drops a Meteorite construct that lasts 30s base, extended +10s via C6 (durationModifier on the summon). 3-4 Geo particles per cast (33% chance for 4).
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(skill, c.skillCD=6s, skillCDStart[0]=23). A1 reduces by 2s → 4s base CD when ascended (ascension≥1). Authored via cooldownModifiers.
Short-Hold variant: hitmark=29f (faster cast), same scaling, separate frame profile (skillFrames[1][0]=InitAbilSlice(54)). Authored as variant with shorter frames; same cooldown/scaling.

Meteorite construct: counts as a Geo construct (Crystallize-able). C2 'Rockcore Meltdown' makes the meteorite explode for 248% ATK Geo when destructed — not authored as separate effect (would need a destruct trigger primitive).
Frames: skillFrames[0][0]=InitAbilSlice(81), ActionDash=25 ActionJump=24 ActionSwap=67. Per E-spec swap/N/Q/D/J — Q defaults to animLen=81.
abilities.description:
Calls upon the power of Geo to summon forth a giant Meteorite that will deal AoE Geo DMG to opponents in front of you upon impact.

The Meteorite remains on the field after impact and acts as Geo-imbued matter. It can also be destroyed by enemy attacks.

abilities.name: Wake of Earth
_curatorNotes: Burst hits: 4 shockwaves at burstHitmark=51 + 15*(i+1) (i=0..3) — so 66, 81, 96, 111f from cast. Per-tick 148% ATK Geo at lvl=10.

Spawns 4 walls (Geo construct shields) at +-2.75/+-6.67 offsets, 15s base duration extended +5s via C6 (durationModifier on the summon). Authored as a single summon entry 'Wake of Earth Wall' representing the wall set. Walls are stationary and don't follow the active char.
Burst frames: burstFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(67), ActionDash/Jump=42 ActionSwap=51. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J — N/E default to animLen=67.
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(burst, 900f, burstStart=35). EnergyMax=60. ConsumeEnergy(37) drains 37 energy from teammates.
C1 Aftershock: party members within radius +10% CR + interrupt RES. Schema-fit: would need a 'duringSummon' state condition on a team buff; possible but not authored — flagged.
C4 Shoreline: -5 Energy per enemy hit (max 25 from one cast). Authored conceptually but per-hit-energy-callback not modeled.

application[]: gcsim internal/characters/traveler/common/geo/burst.go, Traveler.Burst — the 4 shockwaves are QueueAttackWithSnap on the CAST (AttackTagElementalBurst) at burstHitmark+(i+1)*15 with burstHitmark=51, i=0..3 → frames 66/81/96/111. ai.Durability=50 → units 2. ai.Element=attributes.Geo. Nominal schedule per contract C4; gcsim's own ICDTagTravelerWakeOfEarth/ICDGroupDefault suppresses 2 of the 4 (matches gcsim-frames-diff.md §5 row 'Wake of Earth 66f / 15f × 4 · 2/4 standard').

NO summon tick series: the 'Wake of Earth Wall' summon is construct.GeoConstructTravellerBurst (burst.go type wall / newWall) and carries NO AttackInfo at all — it deals zero damage. The §5 summon row is the cast's own 4 shockwaves mis-attributed by abil name ('Wake of Earth'), not a wall cadence. summons[0].effects stays empty.
abilities.description: Energy from deep underground bursts forth, dealing AoE Geo DMG and forming a Stone Stele that deals continuous AoE Geo DMG to opponents within its AoE.

passives.name: Shattered Darkrock
_curatorNotes: Authored on the skill as a cooldownModifiers entry (−2s at ascension ≥ 1); gcsim asc.go `a1` does the same (`skillCD -= 2*60`).

⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15 from genshin-db: the 2026-05-08 hand-written entry filed this text under the A4's name (Frenzied Rockslide) and gated the modifier on `{type:'ascension', level:1}` — a key `evalCondition` never reads (it reads `min`), so the −2s never applied and the skill sat at 6s. The gate is `min: 1` now.

passives.name: Frenzied Rockslide
_curatorNotes: gcsim asc.go `a4`: an AttackTagNormal / ICDTagNone / Durability-25 Geo hit queued `a4Hitmark` (18f Aether, 20f Lumine) after the fifth swing's hitmark (`NormalCounter == NormalHitNum-1`). Authored as an onHit damage effect on the fifth swing (`filter.hitIndex: 4`, 0-based).

⛔ No `application[]`: normals carry none by rule, and the collapse's own Geo application is a second hit off one swing, which the swing model does not express. The gap is one Geo application per N5 — not modelled, not faked.
⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry ('Resonant Waves', Crystallize shielding) was invented — this is the real A4.
passives.description: The final hit of a Normal Attack combo triggers a collapse, dealing 60% of ATK as AoE Geo DMG.

constellations.name: Invincible Stonewall
constellations.caveat: Drawn for the whole field; in play it holds only while the active character stands inside the wall.
_curatorNotes: gcsim cons.go `c1`: a 1s ticker for the wall's life (15 ticks, 20 at C6) that re-applies a 2s +10% CR mod to the ACTIVE character whenever the player is inside `burstArea`. Authored as an active-target onCast-burst buff for the wall's life — two mutually exclusive effects because the wall runs 15s below C6 and 20s at C6 (the summon carries that as a durationModifier, which an effect cannot read).
The interruption resistance has no pixel and is description-only. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry was named 'Aftershock' and carried this text unauthored.

interruptionRes authored 2026-10-12 beside the CRIT Rate pair: “increased resistance against interruption” for party members within the stele’s radius; 15s, 20s at C6. The entry’s caveat already covers standing inside the wall.
constellations.description: Party members within the radius of Wake of Earth have their CRIT Rate increased by 10% and have increased resistance against interruption.

constellations.name: Rockcore Meltdown
_curatorNotes: Fires when the meteorite is destroyed — by its timer or by an opponent — dealing the skill's own DMG again. No construct-destroyed primitive exists and the tool draws no damage numbers, so description-only. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry stated a fixed 200% ATK; the real text ties it to Starfell Sword's own DMG.
constellations.description: When the meteorite created by Starfell Sword is destroyed, it will also explode, dealing additional AoE Geo DMG equal to the amount of damage dealt by Starfell Sword.

A maximum of 25 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.
